title: Add video download, like, comment, channel naming, and quality selection features

requirements.text: Add download button to video player page that allows users to download the video file they are currently viewing

quotes: Video ko download karne ka option

acceptanceCriteria: Download button is visible on the video player page
Clicking the download button triggers a file download of the video
Downloaded video maintains original filename and format

requirements.text: Implement like functionality for videos that allows users to like videos and displays the total like count

quotes: video ko like karne ka option

acceptanceCriteria: Like button is visible on video player page and video cards
Users can click to like/unlike a video
Like count is displayed next to the like button
Like state persists across page refreshes
Backend stores like data associated with each video and user

requirements.text: Add comment system for videos that allows users to post comments and view all comments on a video
acceptanceCriteria: Comment section is visible below video player
Users can write and submit new comments
All comments for a video are displayed in chronological order
Each comment shows the commenter's principal and timestamp
Backend stores comments with video ID, user principal, text, and timestamp

requirements.text: Allow users to set and edit a custom channel name instead of displaying their principal, with support for shorter custom names

quotes: channel name Hai Isko Is Tarah bnao Ki Ham Chhota Naam Rakh sake

acceptanceCriteria: Users can set a custom channel name in their profile or settings
Channel name is displayed instead of principal on video cards, photo cards, and player pages
Users can edit their channel name at any time
Backend stores channel name associated with user principal
Channel name has a maximum character limit for shorter names

requirements.text: Add video quality selector to video player that allows users to choose playback quality for online viewing

quotes: video quality ka Ham video quality ko select kar Saken online

acceptanceCriteria: Quality selector control is visible in video player interface
Users can select from available quality options (e.g., 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p)
Video playback adjusts to selected quality
Selected quality preference is maintained during playback session

constraints: Maintain single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, and components/ui directory
Use only React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn components, and React Query for frontend implementation
All backend logic must be implemented in Motoko
nonGoals: Multi-resolution video transcoding or server-side quality conversion
Real-time notifications for likes or comments
Channel customization beyond name (avatars, banners, descriptions)
